description: One skin analysis with its answers, predictions and zone findings (tables SKIN_ANALYSIS, ANSWER, PREDICTION, ZONE_ASSESSMENT).

user_id.description: Owner of the analysis, the _id of a document in users.

model_version.description: Model name followed by the first 16 hex digits of the model file hash.

ood_score.description: Distance of the photo to the training photos, 0-2; null or absent for a model without the out-of-scope filter.

answers.description: Ticked questionnaire options, one element per option, at most 60.

items.description: One ticked option of one question.

option_value.description: Option code, 1-60 letters, digits or underscores.

predictions.description: Exactly four predictions, one per model category.

items.description: Calibrated probability of one model category.

concern_code.description: Model category: acne, eczema_dermatitis, redness_rosacea or normal_other.

zone_assessments.description: Findings per face zone, at most one per zone (six zones).

items.description: What was seen in one face zone.

zone_code.description: Face zone: forehead, nose, left_cheek, right_cheek, chin or jawline.

finding.description: Short description of the finding, 1-80 characters.

photo_ids.description: Ids of the analysis photos, at most three, copied from photos.
